{{Otheruses|Banks}}
The '''Shevo Banks''' was a site on the planet [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]] that were situated under an ancient series of sea caves that became far removed due to tectonic activity. This area consisted of smooth exposed slopes of rocks that was formed through centuries of water erosion. It was a popular attraction for [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]] who used the formations as slides with the area being always filled with adolescent frolicking members of their kind.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
